summary: The /wc fast-claim path now has enough bounded allocator state to CREATE a contract-complete immutable portfolio pin without deep preclaim archaeology. The allocator emits all mandatory pin fields and lineage; /wc and Fast Allocation validate the shape before CREATE, stop on ALLOCATOR_PIN_PAYLOAD_INVALID, preserve claim-first/EFF001 and the three-attempt cap, and forbid post-create pin repair. EFF011 plus a dedicated static regression test are wired into CI. GitHub Actions passed 80 ratchet checks and 4/4 dedicated tests against a reconciled newer main head.
